title: A small-gap electrostatic micro-actuator for large deflections
subject: Physics
question: What is the approximate normalized strain energy density for the V-shaped NED actuator at an angle of -60 degrees?

gold_answer.long_answer: For the V-shaped NED actuator, at an angle of -60 degrees on the horizontal axis, the corresponding normalized strain energy density on the vertical axis is approximately 0.07 m⁻².
